records.translation: Naliligo sa puso ng bituin...

records.source: Kribbit... Gurrrp...
records.preserveReason: The line consists only of the Gourmand Frog’s nonlexical croaks and is preserved verbatim.

records.translation: Nakatagong dambana sa maulang gubat...

records.source: Inside hard, gold thing...
records.translation: Sa loob ng matigas at gintong bagay...

records.source: The beach resort is open. Temporarily close it down tomorrow?
records.translation: Bukas ang resort sa dalampasigan. Pansamantalang isara ito bukas?

records.source: The beach resort will temporarily close tomorrow. Keep it open?
records.translation: Pansamantalang magsasara bukas ang resort sa dalampasigan. Panatilihin itong bukas?

records.source: The beach resort is temporarily closed. Open it back up tomorrow?
records.translation: Pansamantalang sarado ang resort sa dalampasigan. Buksan ulit ito bukas?

records.source: The beach resort will open back up tomorrow. Keep it closed?
records.translation: Magbubukas ulit bukas ang resort sa dalampasigan. Panatilihin itong sarado?

records.source: The beach resort will be open tomorrow.
records.translation: Magbubukas bukas ang resort sa dalampasigan.

records.source: The beach resort will be closed tomorrow.
records.translation: Sarado ang resort sa dalampasigan bukas.

records.source: The town's 'Lost and Found' box.
records.translation: Kahon ng 'Nawala at Natagpuan' ng bayan.

records.source: The town's 'Lost and Found' box. You can collect incomplete deliveries from past special orders here.
records.translation: Kahon ng 'Nawala at Natagpuan' ng bayan. Maaari mong kunin dito ang mga hindi nakumpletong paghahatid mula sa mga nakaraang Natatanging Utos.

records.source: Collect lost items and incomplete deliveries
records.translation: Kunin ang mga nawawalang bagay at hindi nakumpletong paghahatid

records.source: Retrieve items from offline farmhands
records.translation: Kunin ang mga bagay mula sa mga offline na katuwang sa bukid

records.source: Who would you like to retrieve items from?
records.translation: Kanino mo gustong kunin ang mga bagay?

records.source: Ah... Now this is a truly fascinating piece of natural history! Thank you.
records.translation: Ah... Talagang kahanga-hangang bahagi ito ng likas na kasaysayan! Salamat.

records.source: Beautiful! These bones are exactly what I'm looking for. Now, let me clean my magnifying lens...
records.translation: Maganda! Ang mga butong ito mismo ang hinahanap ko. Ngayon, lilinisin ko muna ang lente ng lente-de-aumento ko...

records.source: You've outdone yourself, @. This is one of the most pristine specimens I've ever seen. Thank you!$h
records.translation: Nahigitan mo ang sarili mo, @. Isa ito sa mga pinakabuong ispesimen na nakita ko. Salamat!$h

records.source: To think... generations have come and gone while this little bone lay hidden beneath the soil. Now it's mine!
records.translation: Isipin mo... lumipas ang maraming salinlahi habang nakatago sa ilalim ng lupa ang munting butong ito. Ngayon ay akin na!

records.source: And would you look at that! With this donation, we've got another full set piece completed.$h#$b#I've got a little something waiting for you behind the counter, when you're ready for it!
records.translation: At tingnan mo nga naman! Sa abuloy na ito, nabuo natin ang isa pang buong bahagi ng koleksiyon.$h#$b#May kaunti akong inihandang bagay para sa iyo sa likod ng mesa, kapag handa ka na!

records.source: Take the shortcut out of the volcano?
records.translation: Dumaan sa daanang palabas ng bulkan?

records.source: I'm taking the day off to visit the island. Please place your money in the box. No cheating!^     -Pierre
records.translation: Nagpahinga ako ngayong araw para bumisita sa isla. Pakilagay ang bayad mo sa kahon. Bawal mandaya!^     -Pierre

records.source: I'm visiting the island today. If you need to buy anything, just leave the money in this box!^     -Marnie
records.translation: Bumibisita ako sa isla ngayon. Kung may kailangan kang bilhin, iwan mo lang ang bayad sa kahong ito!^     -Marnie

records.source: I'm tending the bar on Ginger Island today, but I won't let that stop you from buying something!^     -Gus
records.translation: Ako ang nagbabantay sa bar sa Isla ng Luya ngayon, pero hindi ibig sabihin niyon na hindi ka na makabibili!^     -Gus

records.source: I'm on the island today, but you can still buy something. It's an honor system!^     -Robin
records.translation: Nasa isla ako ngayon, pero maaari ka pa ring bumili. Tiwalaan lang!^     -Robin

records.source: --Shrine Of Challenge--^Dispel the ancient magi-seal of protection, allowing powerful monsters to ascend from the deep?
records.translation: --Dambana ng Hamon--^Alisin ang sinaunang mahiwagang sagisag ng proteksiyon upang makaahon mula sa kailaliman ang malalakas na halimaw?

records.source: --Shrine Of Challenge--^Summon an ancient magi-seal protection, returning the mines to their original state?
records.translation: --Dambana ng Hamon--^Ibalik ang sinaunang mahiwagang sagisag ng proteksiyon upang ibalik ang mga minahan sa dati nitong kalagayan?

records.source: Your request will be granted overnight.
records.translation: Ipagkakaloob ang kahilingan mo magdamag.

records.source: You've already put in a request.
records.translation: Nakapaghain ka na ng kahilingan.

records.source: There's a note from Mr. Qi: ^ I've temporarily disabled this shrine. Come back tomorrow!
records.translation: May liham mula kay G. Qi: ^ Pansamantala kong hindi pinagana ang dambanang ito. Bumalik ka bukas!

records.source: Hey. 150 Magma Sprites, huh? I'm impressed.#$b#Tell you what... I'm gonna give you Marlon's tellie-phone number. He don't like me givin' it out, but I think you've earned it.#$b#If you ever need to use the Item Recovery Service, but don't wanna run all the way out here... just give us a ring. Sound good?
records.translation: Hoy. 150 Espiritu ng Magma, ha? Hanga ako.#$b#Ganito na lang... Ibibigay ko sa iyo ang numero ng telepono ni Marlon. Ayaw niyang ipinamimigay ko iyon, pero sa tingin ko ay karapat-dapat ka.#$b#Kung kailangan mong gamitin ang Serbisyo sa Pagbawi ng Bagay pero ayaw mong pumunta pa rito... tawagan mo lang kami. Ayos?

records.source: Magma Sprites
records.translation: Mga Espiritu ng Magma

records.source: An egg is ready to hatch, but the building is full.
records.translation: Handa nang mapisa ang isang itlog, pero puno ang gusali.

records.source: ...What's that? You'd like me to add a few shortcuts around the valley? Sure, I can do that!^I'll just need 300,000g...
records.translation: ...Ano iyon? Gusto mong magdagdag ako ng ilang daanang pampabilis sa paligid ng lambak? Sige, magagawa ko iyon!^Kailangan ko lang ng 300,000g...

records.source: A sparkling golden chick hatched!
records.translation: May napisang kumikinang na gintong sisiw!

records.source: It seems impossible to budge...
records.translation: Mukhang imposibleng maigalaw...

records.source: Hint
records.translation: Pahiwatig

records.source: Abigail took a life to save mine...#I'll never forget that.
records.translation: Pumaslang si Abigail upang iligtas ang buhay ko...#Hindi ko iyon kailanman malilimutan.
